Games/PelicansatWarriors
Warriors 138Pelicans 87

Warriors rout the Pelicans for an eighth straight

Final · Mon, Nov 9 · Golden State

Stephen Curry and Brandin Podziemski scored 25 each in a 51-point win.

▶ Jump to the play

1 · What happened

The game, in 5 parts.

THE STORY · SCROLL
1 of 5 · First half

How it started.

The Warriors led 35–20 after one quarter. At the half, the Warriors led 72–43.

2 of 5 · The difference

Steph: 25 points in 21 minutes

16 in the third quarter, then he sat the fourth.

3 of 5 · How it turned

Won the third quarter 40–22

Up 29 at the half, the Warriors won the third quarter 40–22 to lead 112–65. Three 20-point scorers combined for 73 of 138.

4 of 5 · Where it was won

Won it from three and off the bench

Threes made 21–8; bench points 60–41. Golden State made 21 of 44 threes.

5 of 5 · Final

Warriors 138, Pelicans 87.

From the Pelicans’ side: Trailed in every quarter; the biggest gap was the third quarter, 22–40.

What it meant: Warriors 8–4, 6th in the West, 26% top-6 odds. Pelicans 4–8, 12th in the West, 0%.

Steph from three.
